summary: MindWalk Holdings Corp. filed a Form 6-K containing a press release that summarizes a systematic report of over 20 partner-owned drug programs derived from its antibody discovery work, ten of which are in active clinical trials. The filing is a routine business update highlighting the company's scientific capabilities and AI platform. No financial terms, transactions, or corporate actions are proposed or executed. As a foreign private issuer's current report on Form 6-K with non-material, non-transactional content, this does not constitute a special situation under any category.
